name: fmfleet
description: Firstmate Fleet for Claude Code: a pane showing one card per live worker (state, last status, estimated context and cost), read from the pulse file bin/fm-fleet-pulse.sh writes. Its hooks module may load through CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS or Claude Code's tengu_plugin_hooks_modules rollout flag, but the mod activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.
